title: Claimed lint hardening did not bite: cross-arm guard still satisfies (verified exit 0 on synthetic probe) and manifest drift is unverifiable (lint never reads demo_update.handle); no bite-tests ship
evidence:
path = "client/src/client.gleam"
...
        window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window
...docstring: "Keep this in sync with the request messages in demo_update.handle — a message listed here must have a demo arm there."
Empirical: I copied lint + client.gleam to /tmp and added an unguarded `vacancy_api.list_vacancies` call in a NEW fn two lines below an unrelated `model.demo_mode` occurrence — lint exited 0 (bleed accepted). A far-placed unguarded call exits 1. The script opens only client/src/client.gleam, so DEMO_INTERCEPTED drift vs demo_update.handle can never fail. Grep of the worktree finds no bite-test file anywhere.
detail: The r3 guard claims depth-aware arm boundaries, manifest verification, and three passing bite-tests. Verified: only 'unguarded arm fails' holds. Cross-arm guard within 35 textual lines satisfies; manifest drift and never-produced triggers are never checked; no automated bite-tests exist. A claimed fix that didn't bite.
recommended_fix: Stop the guard window at the enclosing arm/fn boundary; add a check parsing demo_update.handle arms and failing on DEMO_INTERCEPTED entries with no demo arm; ship the three bite-tests as a script test in test.yml.

title: Deep-link demo boot path (init -> is_demo_route -> enter_demo -> demo_entry_effects) has zero test coverage; r2-B2 NotAsked-on-detail-boot and r2-B4 VacancyEdit prefill arm are unpinned, and the bug-hunt E2E the test header claims does not exist
evidence:
//// resolves it. The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution.
--- demo_flow tests all construct the model directly (fn demo_model() -> model.Model { ... route: routes.Demo, demo_mode: True ... }) or dispatch request/response messages; none calls client.init or enter_demo with a deep-link route. `ls .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/` and grep for demo scenarios return no /demo scenario. The fixes are present in source (client.gleam enter_demo: `vacancies: case route { routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> Loading _ -> NotAsked }`; demo_entry_effects VacancyEdit arm fires demo_api.get_for_edit) but no test would catch their regression.
detail: The r2-B2 (detail boot strands dashboard skeleton) and r2-B4 (edit deep-link boots empty form) regression class lives entirely in the untested init/enter_demo path. The claimed E2E backstop is absent, so these P0-class fixes are source-verified only.
recommended_fix: Add a test driving client.init (or BrowserChangedUrl) with a /vacancies/v-maples and /vacancies/v-maples/edit boot asserting vacancies/dashboard_stats stay NotAsked and vacancy_edit_id is set; add a bug-hunt /demo scenario.

title: report_download_test pins the id mapping but not baked-asset presence — a deleted or misnamed PDF 404s silently in demo (r2 note #33 carried)
detail: The mapping layer is pinned, but the store-side id contract against the shipped static assets is not; dropping or renaming one PDF breaks a demo download with no test failure.
recommended_fix: Add a cheap CI check (shell or test) asserting every report_filenames key has a matching server/priv/static/demo/report-<id>.pdf file.

title: demo_requests_are_intercepted_test still cannot distinguish demo dispatch from a fall-through to the real api dispatch (r2 note #34 carried)
detail: The interception pin is weak: Loading is set by both the demo arm and the real arm it shadows. The mutation tests compensate for create/publish/edit/bulk-reject, but read-only fetches (dashboard, archived, notifications) have no dispatch-distinguishing pin.
recommended_fix: For read-only fetches, assert a store-observable side effect or feed the demo response and assert resolution, as demo_dashboard_resolves_test already does — drop or strengthen the Loading-only assertions.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 <100%. Verified biting: create/publish/edit/bulk-reject dispatch pins (reverting any `let _ = next` fails them — traced through client.update -> demo_update.handle/update_inner with synchronous store threading) and mutation-proof exit-hygiene tests (both exits, per-field NotAsked); 602 client tests green locally. But the deep-link boot path (r2-B2/B4 class) has zero coverage, and the no-network structural guard has a verified cross-arm bleed plus unverifiable manifest drift (2 of 3 claimed lint bites absent). P1 roughly 75-80% (fixtures conformance full; boot, refcheck/notification/close-archive dispatch, analytics firing uncovered); overall ~75-80%.
recommended_fix: Land the two missing lint hardenings plus shipped bite-tests, and add deep-link boot coverage (unit via client.init state assertions, or a bug-hunt /demo E2E). That lifts P0 to 100% and the gate to PASS.
